scripts.postinstall: if [ -z "$VERCEL" ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv sync; fi
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter web dev" "docker compose up --build agents telegram" --names web,runtimes --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others
scripts.env:railway: railway variables --json | python3 -c 'import json,shlex,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); d.pop("DATABASE_URL",None); [print(f"{k}={shlex.quote(str(v))}") for k,v in d.items()]' > .env.local
scripts.update: pnpm update:js && pnpm update:expo && pnpm update:py
scripts.update:expo: cd apps/mobile && pnpx expo@latest install expo@latest && pnpx expo@latest install --fix && pnpx expo-doctor
